Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced.

outcomes.title: Yellow Curve
outcomes.reason: Yellow Curve: Christie’s provenance identifies the 1962 Tooth exhibition, and the actual installation image places the same portrait oval-on-rectangular-ground painting above the fireplace. The43×33in support agrees with the auction description. This join was independently checked by the market researcher; it is not the 1996 Yellow Curve. The Foundation installation caption explicitly supplies EK 293. Source and target photographs were independently viewed in the saved paired comparison.

outcomes.title: York Study
outcomes.reason: Right-hand study: white asymmetrical rounded field against black rectangular painted support. White field meets the top, right and bottom edges as observed. Frame excluded; curvature is approximate. Foundation photograph explicitly labels this title and EK identifier; medium classification remains as sourced.
